page_title: CRY 1-1 FUL | Crystal Palace v Fulham 01/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' The corner kick from Tom Cairney (Fulham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Here is a change. Nathaniel Clyne is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Timothy Castagne (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
85' Kevin goes off the pitch and Harrison Reed (Fulham) comes on.
85' Substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) on for Harry Wilson.
83' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Justin Devenny will be replaced by Romain Esse (Crystal Palace).
82' It will be a substitution. Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) is ready to enter the pitch as Yeremy Pino walks off.
81' The referee is firm and issues Tom Cairney (Fulham) a deserved yellow card.
80' 1 - 1 Tom Cairney (Fulham) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.

77' The game is pretty dull as Crystal Palace are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.
72' The current number of offsides is 4:1.
68' The game is interrupted as Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is flagged offside.
68' Substitution. Sander Berge makes way for Tom Cairney (Fulham).
66' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.
60' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Tony Harrington and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) misses a great opportunity to score after heading the ball onto the left post!
57' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Will Hughes limps off the pitch to be replaced by Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace).
56' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
51' Marco Silva is forced to make a change. Kenny Tete is unable to continue due to injury, Timothy Castagne (Fulham) comes on.
51' Kenny Tete (Fulham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
45+1' The ball spins out to Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just past the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.

39' 1 - 0 Nathaniel Clyne produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
35' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tony Harrington saw the whole situation.
33' Kenny Tete (Fulham) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
29' Tony Harrington has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
25' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
22' Flag goes up against Kevin (Fulham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
21' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner which is cleared.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Kevin (Fulham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
16' Kevin (Fulham) picks up an injury.
15' A long pass, executed by Raul Jimenez (Fulham), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
6' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
4' Wonderful movement by Crystal Palace. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Tony Harrington is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
